_comment: Output quality of the production R9700 + two-XTX-helper layout, each arm a native YAML (native-arms/helper-kld/*.yaml, recipes in native-arms.json) scored by bc-serve quality against a reference this job records first. Arm 'helper-off' is the control (the R9700 alone, no helper: the layout's own distance to the reference); 'helper-on' is gated against it. The reference is the exact two-XTX helper-off run (tp 2, exact wire) over the 4-document corpus; The native owner records it once, on first use, from quality.record (native-arms/helper-kld/reference.yaml, the exact two-XTX tp 2 exact-wire layout; KLD ~0.06 was the XTX re-chunking floor on this corpus) into KLD_REF_DIR, which must not hold a reference yet; delete the record and corpus keys to reuse an existing one. KL mode is prefill-only: max-num-batched-tokens 64 is the helper lane cap and handoff.max-rows 64 sends every step's owned routes through the helpers; speculative drafting is off (a KL run scores the trunk's own rows). The control arm (R9700 alone) holds every expert itself and needs host-pool-mib 45056. Thresholds from the first dev runs (2026-10-17, men11-kld-10171438 and -10171457): KL limits sit well above the 0.0004 mean and 0.05 P99 spread between the two arms; the PPL ratio limit is 0.05 because on this 4-document corpus PPL moves 3% between arms while KL shows no change. Set RAD_BIN (<lane build>/bin/radiance), BC_MODEL_ROOT and KLD_REF_DIR before use; the owner derives the cards and model from each YAML. Static check without a GPU: bc-serve explain NAME --native-config YAML --model-root ROOT --engine-binary BIN.
